name: Curious
description: You ask questions others avoid. Strangers tell you more, and the careful find you a nuisance.

name: Cautious
description: You look before you leap and keep an eye on the road behind you.

name: Kind
description: You are quick with a helping hand, and folk warm to you.

name: Proud
description: You hold your head high; some admire it, and others take offence.
